recipients.name: Visitor location lookup (/whoami)
recipients.purpose: Shows you your own IP address and location; stores nothing.

recipients.name: Hong Kong visitor detection (/api/hk-geo)
recipients.purpose: Detects Hong Kong visitors from the IP at our own edge; only the country code is returned.

recipients.name: Marketing visit log
recipients.purpose: Traffic attribution only, kept apart from your scan and account and never joined to them.

retention.text: Raw IP per country policy (default 7 days); country, source and device 730 days

recipients.note: MPC-9889: person and unknown visits only (functions/_visit-log.ts). IP shaped by the country policy (raw / truncated / none) before it leaves the Worker; referrer host + path; utm tags; country; device class. No user agent, headers or request path: bots and AI go to machine-mirror. Same host also serves the policy read (mpt_visit_log_policy), which sends nothing.

recipients.name: Bot and AI visit record
recipients.purpose: Records which bots and AI crawlers visit, to classify automated traffic.

retention.text: Raw IP 7 days; user agent and network kept for bot forensics

recipients.note: MPC-9889: bot and AI visits only (edge_visits). The row carries request.cf (country, city, network) and the header set for bot forensics; the raw IP window is cut by the retention tasks (MPC-9891).

recipients.name: Scan and report service
recipients.purpose: Runs your scan and delivers your report.

retention.text: Free: deleted 7 days after report delivery; paid: per plan

recipients.name: Account sign-in and your saved scans
recipients.purpose: Emails you a sign-in link and keeps the scans you choose to keep in your account until you delete it.

retention.text: Kept until you delete your account; deleting it removes the account and every scan in it

recipients.note: MPC-9817. You type your own address into the sign-in form and press the button; the sign-in email itself goes out through the resend entry and the login through the supabase entry.

recipients.name: Lead and newsletter capture
recipients.purpose: Stores your sign-up or contact request.

recipients.name: Learning-loop counters
recipients.purpose: Counts which hexagons fire so we can improve the scan; no person key.

recipients.name: Channel bot (Telegram and others)
recipients.purpose: Runs the chat bot and replies to your messages.

retention.text: Telegram history until you ask; state 24 hours; interaction log 90 days

recipients.name: GitHub connect channel (channels.myprivacytool.io)
recipients.purpose: Shows the GitHub profile you chose to connect, and disconnects it on request.
recipients.note: Registered by MPC-9886: the site already called this host from src/lib/githubChannel.ts and it was missing from the registry. Same account as the rest of the platform; no third-party host added.

recipients.name: Sign-in session (OAuth Worker)
recipients.purpose: Tells the site whether you are signed in (a Google sign-in you started), and signs you out.
recipients.note: Registered by MPC-9886: the site already called this host from src/lib/oauthSession.ts and it was missing from the registry. Only called when this browser holds the sign-in hint. No third-party host added.

recipients.name: Deep-dive and ownership-check API (webhook-receiver Worker)
recipients.purpose: Saves the answers you give about a finding and checks you own the address you want to look into.

retention.text: Per the deep-dive and ownership-check retention rules

recipients.note: Registered by MPC-9886: src/lib/hexagonInteractionApi.ts and src/lib/possessionApi.ts call whatever VITE_DEEP_DIVE_API_URL names (unset = nothing is sent). The flag is that variable, so the entry is live only where the site build sets it. If the variable names any other host the wrapper refuses the call, by design: add that host here first.

recipients.name: Cloudflare Turnstile

recipients.name: Cloudflare (serving and rate limits)

recipients.exception: Cloudflare serves the page and enforces rate limits; first-party processing on load is allowed (rule 2)

recipients.name: Google Fonts
recipients.purpose: Web fonts on /footprint and /hexagon-taxonomy. Ended 2026-11-08: both pages now serve their fonts from our own origin.
recipients.note: Ended by MPC-9886: Inter, Fira Code, Bricolage Grotesque, IBM Plex Sans/Mono are self-hosted (latin subsets, SIL OFL 1.1). The registry crawl fails if either host is requested after the until date.
recipients.exception: Ended 2026-11-08 (MPC-9886); kept so the history renders. No call site remains.

recipients.name: Supabase
recipients.purpose: Database that holds saved scans and sign-ups.
recipients.note: MPC-9885: webhook-receiver state-store.js keeps chat conversation state (24 h) whose keys and bodies carry phone, email, name and the platform user id (username); added phone, name, username. MPC-9885: mpt-leads saveBaseline sends SHA-256(email) as email_hash plus the scan scores; added email_hash. MPC-9885: partner-api monitors store the monitored value (email, phone, handle or a domain); added email_domain. MPC-9885: mpt-cairn-blackboard stores the investigation seed email and username and fact values (email, username; phone only if HASH_FACT_TYPES leaves it unhashed); username and phone were already listed (MPC-9885 other tasks). MPC-9885: social-listeners stores Telegram/X updates, probe captures and event-log rows (sender key, @username, name, message text; a shared contact adds a phone); added message_text. MPC-9885: shared/support rest-store.ts keeps support cases (message text and the sender's email, phone or handle); added message_text. MPC-9885: scan-report writes users/leads rows with the visitor IP and utm/referrer, and the listing inputs (name, phone, city, country); added utm, referrer, city, country. MPC-9886: utm added because /HongKongSpam inserts its row (utm_source/medium/campaign, optional email) straight into Supabase from the browser.

recipients.name: Notion
recipients.purpose: Lead log.
recipients.note: MPC-9885: the mpt-leads lead row (workers/mpt-leads/worker.js) also carries city, browser/OS/device (device_profile), UTM tags and the referrer URL; added city, device_profile, utm, referrer. MPC-9885: the Cairn Notion mirror (mpt-cairn-blackboard/notion-sync.js) copies fact values as stored, so usernames reach Notion; added username.

recipients.name: Resend

recipients.name: Stripe
recipients.purpose: Starts a paid-plan Checkout session (gated by CHECKOUT_ENABLED; answers 503 and sends nothing until it is set).
recipients.note: MPC-9885: the entry named a flag (STRIPE_ENABLED) that no code reads. functions/api/stripe-checkout.ts is gated by CHECKOUT_ENABLED, so the entry now says that and is enabled: with the switch off no call is made, exactly as before. The call sends the plan name only (price id and plan in the return URL); the customer's card and email are entered at checkout.stripe.com by the visitor. MPC-9894: Privacy/Cookies must say Stripe is used once checkout is switched on, and that it is currently off.

recipients.name: Pwned Passwords
recipients.purpose: Optional password exposure check in the browser: only the first 5 characters of a SHA-1 hash leave the page (k-anonymity), never the password.
recipients.note: MPC-9886: switched on in the registry because the Pages production build sets VITE_PASSWORD_CHECK=true (verified in the Cloudflare Pages project wwwmyprivacytool, 2026-11-08), i.e. the check is live. The flag still gates the feature.

recipients.name: Meta Graph (Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp)
recipients.purpose: Delivers WhatsApp replies (live) and Messenger replies (the Messenger adapter is still a stub that sends nothing until META_PAGE_ACCESS_KEY is set).
recipients.note: MPC-9885: switched ON because webhook-receiver sendWhatsApp already calls graph.facebook.com whenever META_WHATSAPP_KEY and WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID are set (it was seeded off as 'stubs'). Both senders self-gate on their own secrets, so no flag. phone added (WhatsApp `to`). MPC-9894: Privacy/Cookies must say WhatsApp is live.

recipients.name: Other channel platforms (X, Discord, LINE, Viber, WeChat, Zalo, YouTube)
recipients.purpose: Replies and lookups on the secondary chat/social channels (Discord, LINE, Viber, WeChat, Zalo); each channel runs only when its own switch is on and the sender is allow-listed.
recipients.note: MPC-9885: switched ON because the channel handlers already call these hosts whenever their own switch is on (DISCORD_SCAN, LINE_EXTRAS, VIBER_EXTRAS, WECHAT_EXTRAS, ZALO_EXTRAS) plus an allow-list; the registry flag PLATFORM_REPLIES_ENABLED was read by no code. With every switch off nothing is called. MPC-9894 to confirm which channels are live before Privacy lists them.

recipients.name: Cloudflare API (analytics reads)
recipients.purpose: Reads our own zone traffic totals for the metrics collector; sends no visitor data.
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885. Read-only GraphQL; the request carries our API token and a date range. MPC-9885: flag corrected to CLOUDFLARE_ANALYTICS_TOKEN, the secret the collector reads (it skips the call when unset); CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is not set on that Worker.

recipients.name: Google Analytics Data API (reports)
recipients.purpose: Reads our own GA4 report totals for the metrics collector; sends no visitor data.
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885: collector reads aggregate reports with our service-account token. The tag that sends visitor data to GA4 is the separate `ga4` entry. MPC-9885: flag corrected to GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, the secret the collector requires (GA4_PROPERTY_ID is a constant in code, not an env var).

recipients.name: Google Ads API (account reads)
recipients.purpose: Reads our own Google Ads account configuration (conversion actions, later aggregate campaign stats) for the metrics collector; read-only, sends no visitor data.
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9915. OAuth refresh-token exchange plus GoogleAdsService searchStream only; never a mutate call. Offline conversion upload (Stage C, gclid + timestamp) is a separate decision and would need its own data_items and consent gate (MPC-9882).

recipients.name: YouTube Data API (channel stats)
recipients.purpose: Reads our own YouTube channel statistics for the metrics collector (no visitor data), and, when YOUTUBE_EXTRAS is on, the public channel of an allow-listed commenter (their channel id).
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885. MPC-9885: username added for workers/social-listeners/src/youtube-extras.ts (channels.list with the commenter's channel id). MPC-9894: Privacy must mention it.

recipients.name: Meta Marketing API (ad insights)
recipients.purpose: Reads our own ad account totals for the metrics collector; read-only, sends no visitor data.
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885. Separate from `meta-graph` (Messenger/Instagram/WhatsApp, still stubs and switched off).

recipients.name: Google Firestore (conversation state)

retention.text: Provider-side (document ids carry the channel user id, phone or email)

recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885: webhook-receiver firestore-client.js. Not in the Map's 29; MPC-9894 decides the DPA and Privacy wording. Also added name (the state holds the channel display name).

recipients.name: X (Twitter) API
recipients.purpose: Reads and posts on our own X account (mirror replies, media upload, channel probes).
recipients.note: Added by MPC-9885. `platform-replies` (the reply channels, flag-gated and off) keeps api.x.com too; this entry is the live account-level use. MPC-9885: flag is null, not X_BEARER_TOKEN: the DM, token-refresh and media-upload calls use the OAuth user token / consumer keys and ran without a bearer token, so a bearer flag would newly refuse them (the bearer-only lookups already skip themselves when it is unset).
